from scipy.optimize import least_squares
best=[]
def fam1(p): return p[0]+p[1]*np.sin(p[2]*t**p[3]+p[4])-dv_dt
def fam2(p): return p[0]+p[1]*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[4])+p[5]*t-dv_dt
def fam3(p): return p[0]+p[1]*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[4])*np.exp(-p[3]*t)-dv_dt
def fam4(p): return p[0]+p[1]*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[4])+p[5]*np.sin(p[6]*t+p[7])-dv_dt
for fam,npar in [(fam1,5),(fam2,6),(fam3,5),(fam4,8)]:
    bb=None
    for trial in range(40):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(trial)
        p0=rng.uniform(-1,1,npar)
        p0[2]=rng.uniform(0.3,3); p0[3]=rng.uniform(0.5,1.5)
        if fam is fam4: p0[6]=rng.uniform(0.3,3)
        try:
            s=least_squares(fam,p0)
        except Exception: continue
        val=np.var(s.fun)/np.var(dv_dt)
        if bb is None or val<bb[0]: bb=(val,np.round(s.x,5))
    print(fam.__name__,bb)

def equation(t, x, v, params):
    return params[0]*np.sin(params[1]*t)+params[2]*t+params[3]
